questions.text: The largest number of four digits that is divisible by 12,15 and 18 is ________.
Find the time taken by a 150 m long train, running at a speed of 63 km/h, to cross another train of length 100 m, running at a speed of 45 km/h in the same direction.
A can complete a piece of work in 12 days while B can the same work in 18 days. If they both work together, then how many days will be required to finish the work?
A vehicle travels 200 metres in 5 sec and then another 250 metres in 5 sec. What is its average speed (in meters/sec)?

In a company, the total customer calls on Monday, Wednesday and Friday are 15,500 and the total calls on Tuesday and Thursday are 12,500. The average calls on Saturday and Sunday are 7,000. What are the average calls per day in a week?
In a street there are 20 dogs and cats.If the ratio between dogs and cats is 3:2, then the number of cats is ______.
X,Y and Z can do a piece of work in 4 days, 5 days and 7 days, respectively. They get ₹415 for completing the work. If X,Y and Z have worked together to complete the work, what is X's share?
The average of 48, 39 and y is 40. Find the value of y.

The annual incomes of Anand and Bharath are in the ratio 3 : 5 and their annual expenses are in the ratio 1 : 3. If each of them saves ₹10,000 at the end of the year, then the annual income of Bharath is:
Mukesh sells almonds at the cost price but uses a false weight and thus gains a 23% profit. How many grams of almonds is he giving for 3.075 kg?
A dishonest shopkeeper professes to sell grains at cost price, but he uses a weight of 935 g for 1 kg weight. Find his gain percentage.

In an election between two candidates, one candidate got 60% of the valid votes. If the total number of votes polled were 8850, and 10% of the votes were invalid, then find the number of valid votes that the other candidate got.
A person completes 80 km of a journey at 10 km/h and the remaining 70 km in 7 hours. His average speed for the whole journey is:
By working 12 hours a day, 90 people can complete a work in 16 days. How much work will be left after 24 days if 70 people work for 8 hours per day?
To buy a car, Sahil borrowed some amount at 10% simple interest rate. He has paid some loan amount but ₹1,81,500 is due which he has to pay in 3 years. What will be the annual installment (in ₹)?
A book is sold at a discount of 32% and an additional discount of 25% is allowed on cash payment. If Ramesh purchased the book by paying Rs.2,550 in cash, find the marked price of the book.

In an examination, the ratio of practical to theory marks is 3∶ 7. If 80% of the marks are scored in the practical and 60% of marks are scored in the theory, what is the ratio of marks scored in the theory and the practical?
What annual instalment will discharge a debt of Rs.35,455 due in three years at 12% simple interest per annum (Installments will be paid at the end of the years)(Round off to nearest Rupee)?
The perimeter of an isosceles right-angled triangle having an area of 200 cm2 is:
The height of Ankit was 160 cm last year. In a year, his height increased by 8%. What is his height now?
A solid sphere has a surface area of 616 cm2. This sphere is now cut into two hemispheres. What is the total surface area of one of the hemispheres?
If a shopkeeper sold one-third of his goods at a loss of 20%, then at what gain % should the remainder be sold to gain 25% on the whole transaction?
In an election between two candidates, 84 votes were declared as invalid. The winning candidate secures 62% of the valid votes and wins by 96 votes. The number of votes polled is:
After giving two successive discounts of 30% and 40% on the marked price, an article is sold for Rs.420. Find the marked price of the article.
